close_reason: false positive: run_chain doc comment at lib.rs:773-785 already documents exactly how to identify AnchorIssued position with code example
description: In pkix-lint/src/lib.rs, LintRunner::run_chain (line 792) accepts a kinds slice but the doc comment (lines 777-785) says callers must identify AnchorIssued position manually. The explanation of HOW to do this references pkix_path::names_match but does not explain that for a self-signed anchor (where the root cert == the anchor), the last chain element is the anchor-issued cert. For single-cert self-signed chains (depth=0) the semantics of AnchorIssued vs Leaf are ambiguous. The doc should clarify whether the leaf of a single-cert chain should use SubjectKind::Leaf or SubjectKind::AnchorIssued.
title: SubjectKind::AnchorIssued not documented vis-a-vis LintRunner::run_chain — caller must classify manually
